title: Technical Lead
description:
**About Wednesday**

Wednesday builds software that moves a number the client's roadmap has been stuck on. Since 2020 we have shipped products for companies including PayU, Kotak Securities, PharmEasy, Rapido, and Kalshi. Our engineers work inside the client's production environment and their constraints, and they own the result.

**How we work**

We hire rarely and stay small on purpose, because every person changes what the team is. Everyone here is a forward deployed: a generalist with depth, who sits inside the client's business, finds the actual problem, and owns the number rather than the plan to reach it. We use AI to do most of the building, and we expect people to make those around them better.

**Roles and responsibilities**

You own an engagement and the pod delivering it.

* **Problem framing:**
  Sit with the client's teams, see how the work really happens, and separate the pain that matters from the nice-to-haves.
* **Problem hunting:**
  Find the problems the client has not named yet, and bring them back as things we can build.
* **Client relationship:**
  Be the person the client calls first when something breaks or a new problem shows up.
* **ROI ownership:**
  Set the target with the client and get the pod to hit it. Decide what we reuse, what we build, and what we drop.
* **Architecture and delivery:**
  Design the system, direct the build, and get it running in the client's environment, in production, tied to the number they care about.
* **Running the pod:**
  Mentor engineers on the problem and relationship work, not only on shipping.
* **Domain depth:**
  Learn the client's products, their data, and the rules that constrain what we can build.

**Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  5 to 8 years building software, with at least one system you have architected and taken to production end to end.
* **Stack:**
  Our current stack is JavaScript, Node on the backend, React on the web, React Native and Flutter on mobile, and AWS. We are not limited to it, and we do not expect you to be either. What matters is that you can design and build a system without the technology deciding for you.
* **AI fluency:**
  You use models and agents to do most of your engineering work, you know where they fail, and you can design systems that put LLMs into production reliably.
* **Results in someone else's business:**
  A metric you moved, a stakeholder you brought around, a legacy system you worked through.
* **People:**
  You can run a small team and grow the people on it.
* **Communication:**
  You can explain a technical decision to a head of operations and a compliance officer in the same meeting.

**A note on the title:**
Internally this role is a Lead Forward Deployed Engineer. We post it as Technical Lead because that is what people search for. If you join, your title and level will be set against our engineering ladder based on where you actually fit, which may be above or below the advertised title. The ladder is public: playbook.wednesday.is/forward-deployment-handbook/engineering.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:
  
  
Why Syneos Health
  
  

* We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
* We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
* We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

**Job Responsibilities**
Syneos Health is seeking a highly skilled
**Workday Technical Developer**
to support, maintain, and enhance its enterprise Workday ecosystem. This role is responsible for the full lifecycle of Workday integrations that support Human Capital Management (HCM) business functions. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with a business-focused mindset, delivering day-to-day operational support while designing, developing, and implementing innovative integration solutions. Working closely with HR, IT, external vendors, and a team of integration developers, this individual will ensure reliable, scalable, secure, and high-performing data integrations across the organization's enterprise application landscape.
  
  
**Job Duties & Responsibilities:**
**Integration Support & Operations**

* Provide ongoing production support for Workday integrations supporting HR business processes.
* Monitor integration health and proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve integration issues.
* Perform integration restarts, error resolution, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Respond to incidents, service requests, and production support tickets within established service level expectations.
* Maintain integration documentation, support procedures, and operational runbooks.

**Integration Development**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain new Workday integrations.
* Develop scalable and secure integration solutions using Workday-native technologies and external APIs.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Perform impact assessments and recommend integration architecture improvements.
* Ensure integrations adhere to security, governance, and data privacy requirements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on Workday integration development experience.
* Develop and maintain integrations utilizing:
* Workday Studio
* Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB)
* Cloud Connect
* Core Connectors
* Workday APIs
* REST and SOAP web services
* Reports-as-a-Service (RaaS)
* Workday reporting and calculated fields
* Workday Orchestrate / Orchestration
* Support inbound, outbound, and middleware-based integration architectures.
* Collaborate with internal and external partners to troubleshoot data exchange issues.
* Strong understanding of XML, XSLT, JSON, web services, and API integrations.
* Demonstrated experience supporting Workday’s semi-annual release process, including release review, impact assessment, regression testing, and remediation of integration-related issues.
* Hands-on experience using Jira, ServiceNow or similar enterprise platforms.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Workday Certification or Workday Pro Certification.
* Experience developing and deploying Workday Extend applications.
* Experience with Dashboard and Discovery boards.
* Experience with middleware platforms and enterprise integration patterns.
* Familiarity with security frameworks, data governance, and compliance requirements.

**Team Structure**
This role will be part of the Syneos Technology Solutions (STS) team and will work closely with a small group of Workday team, HR stakeholders, application support teams, and external vendors to deliver reliable and innovative integration solutions across the enterprise.
  
  
**Get to know Syneos Health**
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
  
  
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
  
  
http://www.syneoshealth.com

**SAP SCM EWM Analyst**
****Summary:****
Sr Business Systems Analysts are responsible for analysis, design, testing, and implementation of business processes and the software applications that support these business processes. Sr Business Systems Analysts provide business value through their collaboration with business counterparts and senior application team members, assuring existing business processes are functioning efficiently and designing business process enhancements and extensions. Sr Business Systems Analysts have in-depth knowledge of processes within at least one business function. Sr Business Analysts consult with direct line management to determine work priorities and plans.
  
  
****Responsibilities:****

* Implements business process solutions and enhancements. Working in collaboration with business counterparts and with oversight from senior IT resources, analyze current business processes, elicit new business requirements, develop functional process design, and associated reporting necessary to provide management oversight of the business process. Collaborates with business counterparts and senior application team members to assure integration testing includes all necessary business process variations. Assures business users understanding and acceptance of process changes and test results. Identifies impact on related processes and conducts regression testing of affected areas.
* Develops documentation related to business process design including high level business process overviews, detailed functional specifications, and visual aids such as business process flows. Maintains current documentation as processes evolve over time. Tailors the content of documentation appropriately to the intended audience.
* Performs training of business counterparts related to implementation of new business processes. Shares best practices on current business processes with business counterparts across the organization to assure effective and efficient usage of software applications.
* Leads the implementation of routine process changes and system enhancements with oversight from senior IT resources. Understands project management methodology and the role of the business analyst in the software development lifecycle.
* Develops and maintains business relationships with key business users and managers within their sphere of responsibility. Other duties as needed or required.

****Essential Functions Of The Role:****

* Fully competent in the principles and practices of Business Analysis
* Maintains current knowledge of business and technological trends.
* Flexibility in work schedule, off-hours for project implementation.
* Travel via plane or automobile both locally and internationally, 25% or less

****Work Experience Requirements:****

* Number of Overall Years Necessary: 5-8
* A minimum of 3 years of experience in a related business function
* A minimum of 5 years of experience business process analysis and design with SAP S/4 EWM

****Educational Requirements:****

* BS/BA, or equivalent business experience in a business related discipline
* MBA or advanced degree desirable

****Specialized Skills / Technical Knowledge:****- Processes deep ERP application knowledge in the following functional areas. Application knowledge includes configuration of business processes, key integration points between modules, related master data, and transactional execution. Maintains current knowledge of the business trends and technology developments and applies this knowledge to meet the business challenges.

* Warehousing and Distribution: Process knowledge should include product storage, inventory management, order fulfillment and transportation. Integration knowledge should include connections to order to cash, planning, and finance.
* Purchasing: Process knowledge should include purchase order processing, stock transport order processing, inventory management, and master data (vendor, material, purchasing info records). Integration knowledge should include connection to warehouse management, distribution and finance. Additionally, knowledge of demand planning and supply network planning in SAP IBP is applicable to this specialization.
* Working knowledge of business intelligence tools including, SAP BI, SAP ABAP Query, SAP Report Writer. Applies business intelligence tools to ad hoc analysis of business processes issues and on-going business process monitoring and control.
* Strong expertise in desktop applications essential to the position including Visio for process flow diagrams, Excel and/or Access for large scale data analysis.
* Strong knowledge of business requirements elicitation techniques, such as use cases, prototyping, questionnaires, etc. used in the business analysis discipline. Applies appropriate requirements gathering approach based upon the situation and audience.
* Processes financial acumen necessary to perform basic cost benefit analysis related to low complexity process enhancements.
* Strong analytical skills to identify business needs, formulate viable alternative solutions, and present the business/technical impact of the solutions.
* Strong verbal communication skills including the ability to understand oral descriptions of complex business processes and technical content. Converses with business users using common business vocabulary, avoiding technical jargon. Takes measures to test common understanding including paraphrasing and slowing their speech pattern.
* Strong written communication skills including the ability to document complex business processes and technical content using common business terminology. Uses visual aids like process flows or decision tables to supplement verbal explanations.
